info.name: Brann Coalbeard
info.description: A soot-streaked smith who left the forge when his clan's mountain went quiet.

feats.title: Dwarven Resilience
feats.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

feats.title: Fighting Style: Defense
feats.description: While wearing armor you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

feats.title: Second Wind
feats.description: On your turn, use a bonus action to regain 1d10 + your fighter level hit points. Once per short or long rest.

feats.title: Action Surge
feats.description: On your turn, take one additional action. Once per short or long rest.

feats.title: Improved Critical
feats.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

senses.title: Darkvision
senses.condition: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

actions.name: Action Surge
actions.description: Take one additional action this turn

inventory.title: Warhammer
inventory.description: His grandfather's hammer, rehafted twice.

inventory.title: Handaxe
inventory.description: A balanced throwing axe.

inventory.title: Chain Mail
inventory.description: Heavy armor of interlocking rings.

inventory.title: Shield
inventory.description: An oak shield with the clan's anvil burned into it.

inventory.title: Potion of Healing
inventory.description: Regain 2d4 + 2 hit points.

inventory.title: Explorer's Pack
inventory.description: Backpack, bedroll, mess kit, tinderbox, torches, rations, waterskin and rope.

background.title: Soldier
background.subTitle: Clan guard
background.description: Brann stood the gate of Karak Dunmar for twenty winters before the mountain went silent.

info.name: Seraphine Vale
info.description: An archivist of the Lantern College who reads every book twice, once for the words and once for the margins.

feats.title: Fey Ancestry
feats.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put you to sleep.

feats.title: Arcane Recovery
feats.description: Once per day after a short rest, recover spell slots with a combined level of up to half your wizard level, rounded up.

feats.title: Sculpt Spells
feats.description: Choose up to 1 + the spell's level creatures to automatically succeed on saves against your evocation spells and take no damage.

senses.title: Darkvision
senses.condition: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

actions.name: Shield
actions.description: +5 AC until the start of your next turn

spells.title: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire streaks toward a creature or object within range.

spells.title: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

spells.title: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three glowing darts of magical force, each hitting a creature you can see.

spells.title: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of magical force protects you.

spells.title: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.title: Fireball
spells.description: A bright streak blossoms into an explosion of flame.

spells.title: Counterspell
spells.description: Interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

inventory.title: Quarterstaff
inventory.description: Ash wood, capped in brass.

inventory.title: Spellbook
inventory.description: Bound in grey leather, its margins crowded with another wizard's notes.

inventory.title: Wand of Sparks
inventory.description: Crackles when a lie is told within ten feet.

background.title: Sage
background.subTitle: Archivist
background.description: Seraphine catalogued the forbidden shelves of the Lantern College until she found a book that catalogued her.

info.name: Wren Ashdown
info.description: A lamplighter's daughter who learned every rooftop in Hollowmere before she learned her letters.

feats.title: Lucky
feats.description: When you roll a 1 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can reroll the die.

feats.title: Sneak Attack
feats.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage to one creature you hit with advantage, or with an ally beside it.

feats.title: Cunning Action
feats.description: Take a bonus action on each of your turns to Dash, Disengage or Hide.

feats.title: Fast Hands
feats.description: Use Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools or take the Use an Object action.

actions.name: Cunning Action
actions.description: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action

inventory.title: Shortsword
inventory.description: Short, sharp and easy to hide.

inventory.title: Shortbow
inventory.description: Strung with lamp wick, she insists.

inventory.title: Arrows
inventory.description: A quiver of arrows.

inventory.title: Leather Armor
inventory.description: Patched at both elbows.

inventory.title: Thieves' Tools
inventory.description: Picks, a file and a tiny mirror on a handle.

background.title: Urchin
background.subTitle: Lamplighter
background.description: Wren lit Hollowmere's lamps every dusk until the lamplighters started going missing.

info.name: Tobrin Vell
info.description: A scribe of the Hollowmere archive who read one book too many and followed it out the door.

feats.title: Fey Ancestry
feats.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

feats.title: Arcane Recovery
feats.description: Once per day after a short rest, regain spell slots with a combined level up to half your wizard level.

feats.title: Sculpt Spells
feats.description: Chosen creatures automatically succeed on saving throws against your evocation spells.

spells.title: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire streaks toward a creature or object within range.

spells.title: Light
spells.description: An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20 foot radius.

spells.title: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three darts of force, each striking for 1d4+1.

spells.title: Shield
spells.description: A +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

spells.title: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

inventory.title: Quarterstaff
inventory.description: Ash wood, inked with the archive's catalogue marks.

inventory.title: Spellbook
inventory.description: Bound in lamp leather, every page smells of smoke.

inventory.title: Component Pouch
inventory.description: Chalk, salt and a single owl feather.

background.title: Sage
background.subTitle: Archivist
background.description: Tobrin catalogued the Hollowmere archive until the lamplighters stopped bringing oil for its lamps.

info.name: Maela Brightwater
info.description: A ferry warden of the Hollowmere fens who tracks the fog the way others track deer.

feats.title: Fey Ancestry
feats.description: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

feats.title: Favored Enemy
feats.description: Advantage on Survival checks to track undead, and on Intelligence checks to recall what is known of them.

feats.title: Natural Explorer
feats.description: Difficult terrain in swamps does not slow your group, and you cannot become lost there except by magic.

feats.title: Colossus Slayer
feats.description: Once per turn, a creature below its hit point maximum takes an extra 1d8 damage from your weapon.

actions.name: Hunter's Mark
actions.description: Extra 1d6 damage on every hit against the marked creature

spells.title: Hunter's Mark
spells.description: Mark a creature as your quarry and deal an extra 1d6 damage on every weapon hit.

spells.title: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier in hit points.

inventory.title: Longbow
inventory.description: Yew, strung with waxed fen flax.

inventory.title: Shortsword
inventory.description: Kept for the reeds, where a bow is no use.

inventory.title: Arrows
inventory.description: A quiver of arrows fletched with heron feathers.

inventory.title: Scale Mail
inventory.description: Oiled against the fen damp.

background.title: Outlander
background.subTitle: Ferry warden
background.description: Maela poled the Hollowmere ferry for nine years and knows which lights on the water are not lamps.
